members.name: members
members.description: The group of FoxBasics this offline scene updates.

functions.name: add
functions.description: Adds a member to this offline scene.

functions.name: insert
functions.description: Inserts a member at the given position.

functions.name: remove
functions.description: Removes a member from this offline scene.

functions.name: update
functions.description: Updates every member in this offline scene. Like FoxScene, but no rendering ever happens, useful for classes that only need updating by foxlite (such as FoxAnimationPlayer).

functions.name: destroy
functions.description: Destroys every member and this offline scene.
